title: China alone accounts for nearly a third of the world's CO₂ emissions
description: Share of global CO₂ emissions by country, 2023. Seven countries together produce almost two-thirds of all emissions.
insight: The top seven emitters collectively account for 63% of global CO₂ — the remaining ~200 countries share the rest.
